scope: Storage-only geometry variant; all original row/curvature calculations are unchanged. Does not change any grid, mode, profile, mean quadrature, tail or acceptance condition.
summary_identity: Every field entry is finite; max over a finite partition equals the original global max, with identical float entries. Every original row and chunk remains stored.
allocation_change: Original float64 array becomes temporary-file-backed float64 memmap with the same shape. Flush/MADV_DONTNEED affect residence only. Finite checks and extrema stream over complete rows.
memory_scope: 144 MiB is an observed-peak diagnostic guard checked after preparation/row batches/storage, not an OS-enforced maximum or a prediction of successful execution.
